problem.summary: 设计高效的移动设备神经网络架构，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算量和内存占用，以支持实时推理。

motivation.summary: 现有移动网络（如MobileNetV1）在精度和效率之间仍有改进空间。作者提出通过改进残差块结构（倒残差）和移除窄层中的非线性激活（线性瓶颈）来提升性能，并扩展至目标检测和语义分割任务。

core_idea.summary: 提出MobileNetV2架构，核心创新是倒残差结构（inverted residuals）和线性瓶颈（linear bottlenecks）。倒残差在薄瓶颈层之间使用跳跃连接，中间扩展层使用轻量级深度卷积作为非线性源；线性瓶颈通过移除窄层中的非线性激活来保持表示能力。

method.summary: 基于深度可分离卷积构建倒残差瓶颈块：先通过1x1卷积扩展通道数（扩展因子t），然后进行3x3深度卷积，最后通过1x1线性卷积压缩回低维。跳跃连接在瓶颈层之间。使用ReLU6作为非线性激活。通过宽度乘子和输入分辨率调整模型大小。

experiments.summary: 在ImageNet分类、COCO目标检测（使用SSDLite）和PASCAL VOC语义分割（使用Mobile DeepLabv3）上评估。与MobileNetV1、ShuffleNet、NASNet等基线比较，分析精度、计算量（MAdds）、参数量和延迟。

claims.claim: 倒残差结构比传统残差结构更高效且性能更好。
线性瓶颈对保持低维流形的信息至关重要，移除非线性激活可提升性能。
MobileNetV2在多个任务和基准上达到或超过现有移动模型的精度，同时计算量和参数量更少。
SSDLite和Mobile DeepLabv3是高效的目标检测和语义分割移动解决方案。
倒残差设计允许内存高效的推理实现。

limitations.limitation: 论文未详细讨论在不同硬件平台上的实际部署优化；扩展因子t的选择基于经验；对于极小模型（宽度乘子<0.35）的性能未深入分析；语义分割中ASPP模块的移除会带来精度损失。

nodes.title: 深度可分离卷积
nodes.label: 基础构建块
nodes.summary: 将标准卷积分解为深度卷积和逐点卷积，大幅减少计算量。
nodes.description: 深度卷积对每个输入通道应用单个滤波器，逐点卷积通过1x1卷积组合特征。计算成本约为标准卷积的1/8到1/9。

nodes.title: 线性瓶颈
nodes.label: 设计原则
nodes.summary: 在瓶颈层中移除非线性激活（如ReLU），以保持低维流形的信息。
nodes.description: 实验表明，在窄瓶颈层中使用非线性激活会破坏信息，导致性能下降。线性瓶颈通过保持线性变换来避免信息损失。

nodes.title: 倒残差结构
nodes.label: 核心架构
nodes.summary: 在薄瓶颈层之间使用跳跃连接，中间扩展层使用深度卷积。
nodes.description: 与传统残差连接（连接高维层）不同，倒残差连接低维瓶颈层。这提高了内存效率并略微提升了性能。

nodes.title: 瓶颈残差块
nodes.label: 操作单元
nodes.summary: 由扩展、深度卷积和线性投影组成的残差块。
nodes.description: 具体结构：1x1卷积扩展通道（扩展因子t），3x3深度卷积（带ReLU6），1x1线性卷积压缩通道。跳跃连接在输入和输出之间。

nodes.title: MobileNetV2整体架构
nodes.label: 网络架构
nodes.summary: 由初始卷积层和19个倒残差瓶颈层组成的网络。
nodes.description: 初始层为32滤波器的卷积，随后是19个瓶颈层（见Table 2）。使用ReLU6、批归一化和dropout。通过宽度乘子和输入分辨率调整模型大小。

nodes.title: SSDLite
nodes.label: 目标检测框架
nodes.summary: 将SSD中的标准卷积替换为深度可分离卷积的移动友好版本。
nodes.description: 在MobileNetV2特征提取器上应用SSDLite，显著减少参数和计算量，同时保持竞争性精度。

nodes.title: Mobile DeepLabv3
nodes.label: 语义分割框架
nodes.summary: 使用MobileNetV2作为特征提取器的简化DeepLabv3。
nodes.description: 在MobileNetV2的第二最后特征图上构建DeepLabv3头，使用输出步长16或8。移除ASPP模块可大幅减少计算量但略有精度损失。

nodes.title: 内存高效推理
nodes.label: 实现技巧
nodes.summary: 利用倒残差结构实现内存高效的推理，通过分块计算减少中间张量存储。
nodes.description: 将瓶颈块视为单个操作，内部张量可分块计算，只需存储小块中间结果。这显著降低了内存需求，适合移动设备。

deltas.before: 传统残差连接在高维层之间（如ResNet）。
deltas.after: 倒残差连接在低维瓶颈层之间。
deltas.why_it_matters: 提高了内存效率，并略微提升了精度。倒残差设计允许更高效的推理实现。

deltas.before: 瓶颈层中使用非线性激活（如ReLU）。
deltas.after: 瓶颈层中使用线性激活（移除非线性）。
deltas.why_it_matters: 防止非线性激活破坏低维流形中的信息，提升模型表示能力和精度。
大幅减少目标检测模型的参数和计算量，使其适合移动设备。

deltas.after: Mobile DeepLabv3使用MobileNetV2作为轻量级骨干，并简化头部。
deltas.why_it_matters: 实现高效的移动语义分割，计算量大幅减少。

variables.name: N
variables.description: 非线性逐通道变换（深度卷积+ReLU6）

formulas.intuition: 瓶颈块由三个算子组成：线性扩展、非线性深度处理、线性压缩。这实现了倒残差结构。

variables.name: M(G)
variables.description: 计算图G的内存需求上界

formulas.intuition: 对于具有简单并行结构（如残差连接）的图，内存需求是所有操作中输入和输出张量总大小的最大值。这指导了内存高效实现。
通过将内部张量分成t块，每次只处理一块，从而只需存储一块中间结果，大幅降低内存需求。

terms.definition: 一种残差块设计，其中跳跃连接位于薄瓶颈层之间，而不是传统残差中的高维层之间。

metadata.title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
metadata.venue: 2018 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
metadata.paper_type: Computer Vision / Object Detection / Computer Vision / Segmentation / Computer Vision / CNN / Computer Vision / Top-cited Computer Vision paper
metadata.abstract: In this paper we describe a new mobile architecture, MobileNetV2, that improves the state of the art performance of mobile models on multiple tasks and benchmarks as well as across a spectrum of different model sizes. We also describe efficient ways of applying these mobile models to object detection in a novel framework we call SSDLite. Additionally, we demonstrate how to build mobile semantic segmentation models through a reduced form of DeepLabv3 which we call Mobile DeepLabv3. is based on an inverted residual structure where the shortcut connections are between the thin bottleneck layers. The intermediate expansion layer uses lightweight depthwise convolutions to filter features as a source of non-linearity. Additionally, we find that it is important to remove non-linearities in the narrow layers in order to maintain representational power. We demonstrate that this improves performance and provide an intuition that led to this design. Finally, our approach allows decoupling of the input/output domains from the expressiveness of the transformation, which provides a convenient framework for further analysis. We measure our performance on ImageNet [1] classification, COCO object detection [2], VOC image segmentation [3]. We evaluate the trade-offs between accuracy, and number of operations measured by multiply-adds (MAdd), as well as actual latency, and the number of parameters.

Related Work Tuning deep neural architectures to strike an optimal balance between accuracy and performance has been an area of active research for the last several years. Both manual architecture search and improvements in training algorithms, carried out by numerous teams has lead to dramatic improvements over early designs such as AlexNet [5], VGGNet [6], GoogLeNet [7]. , and ResNet [8]. A substantial amount of work has also been dedicated to changing the connectiv- ity structure of the internal convolutional blocks such as in ShufﬂeNet [20] or introducing sparsity [21] and oth- ers [22]. Recently, [23, 24, 25, 26], opened up a new direc- tion of bringing optimization methods including genetic algorithms and reinforcement learning to architectural search. However one drawback is that the resulting net- works end up very complex. In this paper, we pursue the goal of developing better intuition about how neural net- works operate and use that to guide the simplest possible network design. Our approach should be seen as compli- mentary to the one described in [23] and related work. In this vein our approach is similar to those taken by [20, 22] and allows to further improve the performance, while providing a glimpse on its internal operation. 3.1. Depthwise Separable Convolutions Depthwise Separable Convolutions are a key build- ing block for many efﬁcient neural network architectures [27, 28, 20] and we use them in the present work as well. The basic idea is to replace a full convolutional opera- tor with a factorized version that splits convolution into two separate layers. The ﬁrst layer is called a depthwise convolution, it performs lightweight ﬁltering by apply- ing a single convolutional ﬁlter per input channel. The second layer is a 1× 1 convolution, called a pointwise convolution, which is responsible for building new fea- tures through computing linear combinations of the in- put channels. Standard convolution takes an hi× wi× di in- put tensor Li, and applies convolutional kernel K ∈ Rk×k×di×dj to produce an hi× wi× dj output ten- sorLj. The constraints of the lemma 2 can be empirically validated for real networks and real inputs and hence we can be assured that information is indeed preserved. and therefore ReLU(Bx) performs a nonlinear transfor- mation while preserving information with high proba- bility. We discussed how bottlenecks can prevent manifold collapse, but increasing the size of the bottleneck expan- sion may also make it possible for the network to repre- sent more complex functions. Following the main re- sults of [47], one can show, for example, that for any in-
tegerL≥ 1 andp> 1 there exist a network ofL ReLU

layers, each containing n neurons and a bottleneck ex- pansion of sizepn such that it maps pnL input volumes (linearly isomorphic to [0, 1]n) to the same output re- gion [0, 1]n.
